capabilities.description: Start a local provider session in an approved workspace.
Send a follow-up prompt to an existing local provider session.
Read status and streamed events from a local provider session.
Cancel a running local provider session.
Read the workspace diff after a local provider runs.

metadata.setup: Run Agent Kernel Desktop or the local computer bridge on the working computer, pair this app once, then choose a provider such as Codex. Each session may select the allowed root or any repo underneath it. The bridge defaults to Codex no-sandbox mode for hosts where bubblewrap sandboxing is unavailable; pass --sandbox workspace-write or --sandbox read-only when those modes work locally.
